title: Geometry-Controlled Exceptional Points in Helicoidal Orbital-Angular-Momentum Photonics
summary: Exceptional points (EPs) are non-Hermitian spectral singularities where eigenvalues and eigenvectors coalesce. We propose a geometry-controlled route to EPs in orbital-angular-momentum (OAM) photonics. In an effective torsion-free helicoidal background, the twist supplies a signed, real chiral splitting between opposite-OAM modes, while openness, gain, loss, leakage, or channel coupling, supplies the non-Hermiticity.
